about_the_game:
Welcome to the Cutting Edge of Battle. Honor the legacy of the elite infantry operators that serve as Army Rangers. Charge into battle with the Lead the Way Pack* — inspired by the 75th Ranger Regiment and our creative collaboration with the National Ranger Association.

The Lead the Way Pack includes:
  • “Regiment” NATO Assault Soldier Skin
  • “Hold Fast” Glider 96 Vehicle Skin
  • “Legacy Strike” M277 Weapon Package
  • “All the Way” Soldier Patch
  • “Sua Sponte” Dog Tag
  • “Battleworn” Parachute
  • 60 min Battle Pass XP Boost
  • 1 Tier Skip

Battlefield is honored to invest in the important work of the National Ranger Association in its mission to support iconic Army Rangers and the Ranger community. Through our partnership, we've collaborated with retired Rangers to bring their prestige and honor to the world of Battlefield.
